7. INSTALL OVERDRIVE DIRECT CLUTCH ASSEMBLY
(a) Align the flukes of the discs in the direct clutch.
(b) Install the direct clutch assembly onto the O/D planetary gear.

8. CHECK OPERATION OF ONE-WAY CLUTCH
Hold the O/D direct clutch drum and turn the input shaft. Check that the input shaft turns freely clockwise and locks counterclockwise.
